citations.title: Equivalence of Emergent de Sitter Spaces from Conformal Field Theory

claims.statement: A Crofton form on the relevant space of geodesics can compute bulk curve lengths by integration over intersecting geodesics.
claims.scope: the cited AdS3 integral-geometric construction and normalization

claims.statement: MERA has been argued to discretize kinematic space rather than the bulk spatial slice itself.
claims.scope: the structural correspondence and examples analyzed by the source

claims.statement: Related emergent de Sitter descriptions arise from entanglement, causal diamonds, and MERA in selected two-dimensional CFT states.
claims.scope: the vacuum, thermal, and nontrivial cases treated in the source

limitations: The packet does not identify inclusion order, Lorentzian metric, and Crofton measure as the same structure.
Bulk points are generally represented by families of geodesics rather than single kinematic points.
Tensor-network correspondences remain dependent on the network and holographic setting.
